title: End-of-Term Choices Under the SunPath Solar Lease
content:
At the end of its term, every SunPath Solar Lease offers the same three options: **renew**, **purchase** or **remove**.

| Tier | Options at the end of the term | Length of a renewal | Fee to remove the system at the end of the term |
|---|---|---|---|
| SunPath 3.2 kW | Renew, purchase, remove | 5 years | $0.00 |
| SunPath 4.0 kW | Renew, purchase, remove | 5 years | $0.00 |
| SunPath 4.8 kW | Renew, purchase, remove | 5 years | $0.00 |
| SunPath 5.6 kW | Renew, purchase, remove | 5 years | $0.00 |
| SunPath 6.4 kW | Renew, purchase, remove | 5 years | $0.00 |
| SunPath 8.0 kW | Renew, purchase, remove | 5 years | $0.00 |

### The terms of the table

- **Options at the end of the term** — the options available when the lease term ends: renew the lease, purchase the system, or have the system removed.
- **Length of a renewal** — a renewal at the end of the term runs for 5 years.
- **Removal fee** — the fee in US dollars to remove the system at the end of the term, which is $0.00 for every size; choosing removal at the end of the term carries no charge.

### Questions the table answers

**Does a larger system have different end-of-term options?** No. All six sizes list renew, purchase and remove.

**How long does a renewed lease run?** 5 years, for every size.

**What does removal at the end of the term cost?** Nothing: the removal fee at the end of the term is $0.00 for every size.
